doc: Field villager behaviour (M3-CRE-610, docs/kb/tech/field_npc.md): FieldNpc (game/world/npc/field_npc.gd) idles, talks, turns to face the player and walks short routes. Metres, seconds, degrees. `defaults` apply to every villager; `villagers.<npc_id>` overrides any key (nested dictionaries merge). `locomotion` is merged over game/data/hero_motion/hero_motion.json and handed to HeroLocomotion, so the turn and the gait filter are the hero maths with villager tuning.

locomotion.doc: Villagers turn slower and softer than the heroes, and their gait filter is longer so a start or a stop rolls through the walk. walk_clip_mps: the speed at which the villager walk clip's feet plant (measured from the M2-CHR-03 adult walk: ~0.37 m of foot travel per 0.55 s stance).

osu.doc: The elder: a slower turn, a longer settle back to rest.
